case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
sup:70510.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
sup:70510.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

You pointed to copper and your cost structure, and Option B answers that directly: we take the copper risk above the deadband through an index clause on CU-NOTATION, so your base price needs no risk premium.

On quality:
Your quality was 273 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70510@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 358.48; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 359.59; payment 60 days net; index clause on CU-NOTATION (20 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08).
Option C: unit price EUR 358.41; payment 14 days net; no index clause.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a firm unit price on a payment term longer than your standard, and the quality record above supports it. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Because a step of this size goes to your pricing committee, here is a paragraph you can forward unchanged:

Could you take Option A to your approver? If the committee needs anything further to decide, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified the quality record you cited; however, the defect rate remains within our standard operational tolerances and does not warrant a price adjustment. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. Our Angebot stands at a price of €359.59 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Quality Management: We meet the agreed quality targets.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
